Hi Emma —

Quick note: I just learned Daniel (your CTO) has a short layover in SFO on Nov 12 and can step into a call for ~30–45 minutes between 13:00–14:30 PT. He’d prefer a short, focused walkthrough that highlights integration economics and SLA behavior under burst load.

Would Acme be open to compressing the demo we scheduled for Nov 12 at 11:00 PT into a 45-minute condensed walkthrough starting at 13:15 PT so Daniel can join during his layover? Our aim would be a 15-minute exec overview + a 25–30 minute tech Q&A.

If that window doesn't work for you, we can keep the original time and have Karthik run the technical deep-dive with Ben on the call as backup. No problem either way — want to make this easy for your team.

Attached an edited agenda (redwood-demo-agenda-v2.pdf) and I’ll send an updated invite (calendar-invite-updated.ics) if we land on the new slot.

Thanks,
